==Reading==

Currently reading ... nothing! Eagerly awaiting the next installment.


Just finished reading [[New Spring]]. Nice to get back into the Wheel of Time universe, even though it was only brief!


And before that:

* [[Crossroads of Twilight]]. Hmm. The pacing of this seemed excruciatingly slow. Nothing seemed to actually happen! The Perrin storylines haven't been all that interesting in quite a while, and the emerging So Habor plotline seems highly unnecessary considering the myriad other threads that remain untold and unresolved. Also, spending only half a chapter (more or less) on the main characters of the series, doesn't seem like a good idea. Oh well. Let's hope the next one is better.
